WITH currency_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as benchmark_value
  FROM currency_stats
),
filtered_currencies AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.avg_rebtotal,
    cs.avg_relative_gap,
    (cs.avg_rebtotal - bc.benchmark_value) as excess
  FROM currency_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc
  WHERE bc.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.avg_rebtotal IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.avg_rebtotal > bc.benchmark_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebate,
  AVG(avg_relative_gap) as mean_avg_relative_gap,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM filtered_currencies
